page.title: Eden's Veil
page.subtitle: A mythical sanctuary rediscovered.
page.heroDescription: Featuring a botanical stained glass design and a hand-painted gold or silver sigil. Each design is complemented by authentic oak or walnut slatted front panels.
page.about: In a realm between realms, beyond the reach of mortal maps lies Eden’s Veil, a sanctuary of knowledge that reveals itself only to those chosen.

embed.title: Eden's Veil | A Limited Edition PC by Ironside

content.title: Beyond the Ordinary
content.description: Crafted to resonate with your unique taste and aesthetic, Eden’s Veil is a magical blend of design and function that takes a step outside of conventional.

content.title: The Sacred Sigil
content.description: Hand-painted sigils grace the front panel, masterfully crafted to evoke a sense of time-worn elegance with an artfully distressed, aged finish.

content.title: Wondrously Wooden
content.description: The front panels are crafted from real oak or walnut, featuring slatted designs that bring a touch of natural elegance to your setup. These carefully selected materials add warmth and texture, blending organic beauty with modern functionality.

content.title: Widowbloom
content.description:
They say there is a garden beyond Eden’s Veil that no gardener will tend. The flowers there open at dusk, petals dark as a widow’s dress, and turn only to the shadowed moon.

Deep violet glass, tangled branches, and blood red roses beneath a crescent moon bring the forgotten garden of Widowbloom back to life.

Widowbloom is our newest stained glass design for Eden’s Veil, printed pane by pane.

The garden is open.

content.title: The Dawn/Dusk Dichotomy
content.description: Available in two captivating colorways—Frostvine, evoking the brighter and more vibrant energy of daylight, and Ravenroot, reflecting the more subdued and moody hues a moonlit evening.

content.title: Grimthorn Emerges: A Haunting Reimagining of Eden’s Veil
content.description: Meet Grimthorn, the darker evolution of Eden’s Veil. Inspired by toxic plants and shadowy gardens, this edition wraps the design in deep purples and magentas, perfect for those drawn to the beauty of the macabre.

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
